name: webhook-only-ruleset
title: Load webhook-only rulesets (forward rule with pushTo and no Telegram destination)
description: The ruleset loader rejects any file whose forward rules have no Telegram destination (to), because check() requires non-empty UniqueDestinations. A rule that only pushes to external webhooks (pushTo) therefore fails Load() with ErrEmptyConfig and the engine skips push initialization entirely. Relax check() so a ruleset with at least one rule that has pushTo (or to) loads, keeping the empty-file rejection.
scope: loader-only; no handler, delivery, or schema changes
creator: killbus
notes: User requested the fix on 2026-10-16 (option 1 of the ruleset discussion) to enable webhook-only rulesets for inspecting the v2 facts.
